title: 第六十五章 心有不平气我自当杀人弟兄们看过来
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 暗中瀛溟国的高手内心瞬间沉到了最谷底，但却依旧没有立马出现...
万一那老将只是诈他呢？
“不愿出来，那你就永远不要出来了。”
林玄声音冰冷，随手一挥。
轰！
一股无形劲力直接向着一侧的老槐树上方极速冲去。
老槐树上顿时爆出大片白雾。
一道人影一闪而过，快到极致。
在从老槐中闪出之后，他的身躯就紧跟着瞬间消失，遁地不见。
刚一遁地，便直接从地面上射出无数地刺，密密麻麻，冲向林玄。
但林玄眼神冰冷，一步踏出，瞬间窜出。
一切射来的地刺在接触他的刹那，统统炸开。
地刺炸开之后，跟着有一条狰狞巨大的土龙，从地底钻出，发出嘶吼，猛然缠向林玄。
林玄扬手一拍。
轰的一声，土龙被他拍的生生爆碎。
而后他脚掌一踏，又快又狠，一股劲力好似螺旋一样，沿着地面，瞬间钻入地底，摧毁拉朽，力量恐怖。
哗啦！
那道人影从地底之中被当场逼出，突然间在半空中一分为三，真真假假，三道人影全都向着林玄直扑而去
影分身之术！！！
砰砰砰！
林玄出手如电，速度如风。
掌击、肘打、拳冲。
三道人影全都爆开，化为白雾。
无一例外，皆为虚假。
打爆他们的刹那，林玄便是大手一抓，气息冰冷摄人。
轰！
虚空之中竟突然浮现出透明大手，化为无形场力，一把抓向一侧的虚无，直接将那片虚无都给直接禁锢。
隐藏在虚无之中的那位瀛溟国高手脸色骤变，原本还处在三具影分身被林玄同时打爆的震惊中，浑然没有想到，一股无形场域竟已瞬间笼罩住他的身躯。
就如同被一只大手给抓住了一样，向着林玄那边猛然飞去。
擒龙功！！！
那瀛溟国高手竭尽全力的挣扎，却完全没用，不管什么秘术统统发挥不出来。
他猛然回头，张口一喷。
轰！
大片高温火焰瞬间从嘴巴冲出，好似魔龙，直袭林玄而去。
但林玄眼神冰冷，精气神汇聚，直接一拳砸出，洁白色气流包裹周身，好似一条白色的恐怖苍龙。
一切火焰统统爆开，空气都好似被直接打的干瘪、凹陷。
脑袋炸碎。
断骨、碎肉被劲力包裹，向着四面八方到处激射。
“乱七八糟！”
他声音冰冷，收回拳头。
无头尸体直接被无形大手松开，坠落在地。
林玄在尸体身上搜刮起来。
content_en:
Secretly, the master of Yingming Kingdom suddenly felt his heart sink to the lowest point, but he still did not appear immediately...
What if the veteran just cheated him?
"If you don't want to come out, then you should never come out."
Lin Xuan's voice was cold and he waved his hand casually.
boom!
An invisible force rushed directly to the top of the old locust tree on one side at high speed.
A large white mist suddenly burst out from the old locust tree.
A figure flashed past, extremely fast.
After emerging from the old locust tree, his body disappeared in an instant and disappeared.
As soon as he escaped from the ground, countless thorns were shot out from the ground, densely packed, and rushed towards Lin Xuan.
But Lin Xuan's eyes were cold, he took one step and jumped out instantly.
All the incoming thorns exploded the moment they touched him.
After the ground thorn exploded, a ferocious and huge earth dragon emerged from the ground, roared, and suddenly wrapped around Lin Xuan.
"Get out!"
Lin Xuan raised his hand and clapped it.
With a bang, the earth dragon was smashed to pieces by him.
Then he stepped with the sole of his foot, fast and hard, a force like a spiral, along the ground, instantly burrowing into the ground, destroying everything, the power was terrifying.
Wow!
The figure was forced out of the ground on the spot, and suddenly split into three in mid-air. Real and fake, the three figures all rushed towards Lin Xuan.
Shadow Clone Technique! ! !
Bang bang bang!
Lin Xuan's shots were like lightning and his speed was like wind.
Palm strikes, elbow strikes, punches.
All three figures exploded and turned into white mist.
Without exception, they are all false.
The moment he defeated them, Lin Xuan grabbed them with his big hand, his breath cold and breathtaking.
"Get out!!!"
Boom!
A large transparent hand suddenly appeared in the void, turned into an invisible field force, grabbed the void on one side, and directly imprisoned the void.
The expression of the Yingming Kingdom master who was hidden in the void suddenly changed. He was still in shock when three shadow clones were exploded by Lin Xuan at the same time. He had no idea that an invisible field would instantly envelope his body.
As if being caught by a big hand, he flew suddenly towards Lin Xuan.
Capturing the dragon! ! !
The master of Yingming Kingdom tried his best to struggle, but it was completely useless. No matter what secret skills he had, he couldn't use them.
He turned back suddenly and spat out.
boom!
A large swath of high-temperature flames instantly rushed out of his mouth, like a dragon, and headed straight for Lin Xuan.
But Lin Xuan's eyes were cold, and he gathered his energy and energy and punched out directly. The pure white air flow wrapped around his body, like a terrifying white dragon.
All the flames exploded, and the air seemed to be shriveled and dented directly.
Bang! ! !
Brains exploded.
Broken bones and minced flesh were wrapped in force and shot out in all directions.
"What a mess!"
His voice was cold and he retracted his fist.
The headless corpse was released by invisible hands and fell to the ground.
Lin Xuan searched the body.
title_en: Chapter 65: If I feel grievances, I will treat myself as a murderer. Brothers, look over.
